name: Grok
desc: xAI's real-time conversational assistant with X platform data
desc_zh: xAI 的实时对话助手，融合 X 平台数据
solves: News breaks faster than search indexes it, and you want the reaction, not the press release. It reads X in real time.
solves_zh: 新闻跑得比搜索引擎收录更快，而你想看的是现场反应，不是通稿。它实时读取 X 上的内容。
best_for: When you want a live read on what people are saying right now about an event.
best_for_zh: 当你想实时了解此刻人们正在怎么谈论一件事时。
